# UK Property Tribunal Rent Repayment Order (RRO) & Section 13 Precedent Finder
> Zero-token deterministic index of 281 real GOV.UK First-tier Tribunal (Property Chamber) RRO decisions under Housing Act 2004 (s.72 HMO / s.95 Selective Licensing) & Housing and Planning Act 2016 (ss.40-44).
> License: Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/)
> Live UI: https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/rro
> Sitemap: https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/sitemap.xml

## National Benchmark Summary (281 Real GOV.UK Decisions)
- Positive RRO Awards: 179 / 281 decisions
- Median Tribunal Award % of Rent: 60.0% (Range: 2.3% to 100.0%)
- Median Monetary RRO Award: £3,400.00
- Total Rent Claimed Across Indexed Cases: £1,900,103.67
- Total RRO Awarded Across Indexed Cases: £1,111,752.92
- Top s.44 Mitigation & Deduction Factors: financial_hardship (241), delayed_council_application (223), utilities_deducted (223), universal_credit_deducted (213), director_liability (201), good_condition (170), letting_agent_reliance (113), professional_landlord_aggravation (110), tenant_conduct (71), fire_safety_breach (69), first_offence (55), deposit_unprotected (8), s44_statutory_conduct (5)

## Machine-Readable API Endpoints
- GET https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/api/rro-search?q=Ealing&region=London&offence_type=Selective&mitigation=utilities_deducted
- GET https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/api/rro-search?format=csv (Download Regional RRO Precedent Pack CSV)
- GET https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/api/rro-seo-pages (Full JSON bundle of all 88 programmatic borough, region & offence precedent pages + Schema.org Dataset/FAQPage JSON-LD)
- POST https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/api/rro-audit-pdf (Stateless zero-retention private RRO claim/PDF exposure auditor)
- GET https://parish.technoplusit.co.uk/rro/stats (Live Zero-PII North Star usage telemetry)
